mapper.select: select count(distinct credit_code) from risk_control_warn_monitor where handle_status in ('PEND_HANDLE','HANDLE_ING','REJECTED')

SELECT count(distinct (credit_code)) from( select credit_code,COUNT(1) AS handleing_count from risk_control_warn_monitor where handle_status in ('PEND_HANDLE','HANDLE_ING','REJECTED') AND credit_code in (select distinct(credit_code) from risk_control_warn_monitor where handle_status in ('CLOSED','HANDLED') and update_time > curdate()) GROUP BY credit_code) tmp where tmp.handleing_count = 0;
select * from risk_control_warn_monitor where create_time > date_add(curdate(),interval -5 day) order by create_time

select a.id,b.name as deptName from risk_control_warn_monitor a left join client c on a.credit_code = c.usc_code left join bifrost_org b on b.id = c.belong_dept_id where handle_status in ('PEND_HANDLE','HANDLE_ING','REJECTED')

select data_time as date, title as warnTitle, warn_code as warnCode, if(warn_level=3,'红灯','黄灯') as warnLevel, handle_status as warnStatus from risk_control_warn_monitor a left join client c on a.credit_code = c.usc_code where c.id = #{clientId} order by a.create_time desc

select count(1) from risk_control_warn_monitor where handle_status = 'HANDLE_ING'
and warn_level = #{warnLevel}
select risk_type as cardCode, count(1) as amount from risk_control_warn_monitor where handle_status in ('PEND_HANDLE', 'HANDLE_ING', 'REJECTED') and risk_type is not null group by risk_type
SELECT MAX(warn_code) FROM risk_control_warn_monitor WHERE warn_code LIKE CONCAT('YJ', #{dateStr}, '%')
